description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (expressed as a percentage on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 100) and two metrics: perplexity (plotted on the left y-axis, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7) and GPU memory ratio (plotted on the right y-axis, ranging from 40% to 100%). The data includes four distinct lines: "Perplexity" is represented by an orange line with circular markers, "Full Cache PPL" by a red dashed line, "GPU Mem. Ratio" by a blue line with circular markers, and "Full Cache GPU Mem." by a dark blue dashed line. The "Perplexity" line starts at a value of approximately 4.6 at a recent sequence ratio of 0%, decreases sharply to about 4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly before rising again to around 4.4 at 100%. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line shows a steady increase from approximately 42% to 98% across the same range. The "Full Cache PPL" line remains constant at 4.4, while the "Full Cache GPU Mem." line is constant at 100%.
